src.title: SVG file
opt.size_file_px: File without a size: {w} × {h} mm at 96 px per inch
layer.starts: starts {mm} mm from the bed, above the first layer
layer.height_hint: For a thickness in layers. Empty: the project's (or the printer profile's).
frame.hint: In “On the object”, drag the design to move it and its corner to resize it; it stays on the surface.
opt.max_colors_hint: How many filaments your printer can use. 0 = no limit.
wiz.title: How many colors?
wiz.title_drawing: Which part of the file, at what size?
wiz.hint_drawing: Leave out layers you do not want, choose the size and mirror it if needed.
wiz.hint_filaments: Match the colors to the loaded filaments, or give the project's filaments the colors of the drawing.
wiz.hint_finish: How detailed the edges are, how thick the colors are and where the design sits on the surface.
wiz.one_layer: This file has a single layer.
wiz.match: Match each color to the closest filament
wiz.project_colors: Drawing colors in the project's filaments
wiz.project_colors_note: When applying to the plate, each filament used takes the color of its part (the largest one when parts share it). Only the filaments the project already has.
wiz.simplify_hint: Detailed keeps more of the drawing; Simplified cleans tips and slivers up to 0.6 mm.
wiz.hint: Each color becomes a part with its own filament. Pick how many the design will have; you can change it later.
wiz.open: Assistant: layers, size, colors, filaments and finish
wiz.ask: Open the assistant when choosing an SVG
pop.hint: Click a color of the drawing to choose its filament; Ctrl+click selects several.
opt.merge_hint: 0 = off. Higher values join colors that look alike (ΔE).
base.hint: 0 mm = no base. With a base, the colors sit on top of it (new 3MF only).
adv.hint: A smaller precision keeps more detail and makes bigger files.
adv.min_detail_hint: Lines and sharp tips narrower than this (about your nozzle width) go to the neighboring color, without gaps, and corners round to half of it. 0 = off.
col.name: Part name
col.background_hint: This color spans the whole drawing. Untick it if it is only a background.
col.recolor: Change the color of this part
col.beyond_filaments: some filament numbers are above the {n} loaded in OrcaSlicer
prev.empty: Choose an SVG to see how it will be split.
target.title: Apply to
target.new: A new object on the plate
out.stl: Also save one STL per color
apply.height_hint: Empty: in proportion to the width. A height of its own stretches the design (Shift + drag its corner does the same).
frame.fill_hint: The design covers the whole surface, in proportion and centered: no edge is left over; what goes past it is cut off.
prev.past_edge: goes past the surface: what is outside is cut off
apply.dirty: The open project has unsaved changes. Save it (Ctrl+S) before applying.
plate.hint: OrcaSlicer's plugin API cannot change the plate directly: the design goes into the saved project, which reopens here with the new parts. Save the project (Ctrl+S) first, and when OrcaSlicer asks, choose “Open as project” (“Import geometry only” would add the objects again).
status.saved_project: Project updated: {path}. The original is in {backup}.
plate.presets_only: Project: {name} · presets have unsaved edits (they do not block applying: the project reopens with the settings saved in it)
place.seen_top: Seen from above, like OrcaSlicer's top view ({keys})
place.seen_bottom: Seen from below, like OrcaSlicer's bottom view ({keys})
place.seen_front: Seen from the front, like OrcaSlicer's front view ({keys})
place.seen_back: Seen from behind, like OrcaSlicer's rear view ({keys})
place.seen_left: Seen from the left, like OrcaSlicer's left view ({keys})
place.seen_right: Seen from the right, like OrcaSlicer's right view ({keys})
place.turn: Turn the view 90° (only how it is shown: the result does not change)
paint.brush: Brush: paint with a color of the drawing
paint.bucket: Bucket: fill a bare area with the color next to it
paint.clear: Remove all the paint on this surface
paint.hint_brush: Drag to paint; the stroke takes the color where it starts. A click on a color picks it.
paint.hint_bucket: Click an area of the surface the design leaves bare: it takes the color next to it.
paint.no_color: Pick a color first: click a color of the drawing.
paint.nothing: Nothing to fill there: click an area of the surface the design leaves bare.
paint.filled: Filled with the color next to it.
plate.no_match: {name} is not in the saved project yet. Save it (Ctrl+S) and read the plate again.
face.label: {dir} · {w} × {h} mm
objects.label: {name} · {size} · {parts} part(s)
status.plate_unsaved: None of the objects on the plate comes from a saved .3mf. Save the project first (Ctrl+S).
status.matched: Filaments matched to the closest colors.
status.reopening: Opening the result in OrcaSlicer… choose “Open as project”.
progress.details: Handing thin details to their neighbors…
warn.gradient: Gradients were replaced by the average of their colors.
warn.unknown_paint: Some paints (patterns or missing references) were ignored.
warn.transparency: Semi-transparent shapes are treated as opaque.
warn.text: The SVG has text that is not converted to paths. Convert text to outlines in your editor.
warn.clip_mask: Clipping paths and masks are ignored. Release them in your editor if shapes show up where they should not.
warn.dashes: Dashed outlines are printed as solid lines.
warn.empty_part: {name} ended up empty and was skipped.
warn.exceeds_face: The design was larger than the surface allows ({w} × {h} mm: covering it and 25% more) and was reduced.
warn.too_thick: The thickness is larger than the object's depth under this surface.
warn.not_watertight: Not watertight (the slicer will usually repair it): {names}
warn.project_filaments: The project has only {n} filament(s); OrcaSlicer will print these parts with filament 1: {names}. Add filaments to the project or choose others.
error.no_object: Choose an object of the project.
error.no_regions: No filled area left after processing the SVG.
error.stale_colors: The colors changed since the analysis. Analyze again.
error.same_output: The output must be a different file from the project.
error.svg_no_shapes: No filled shape was found in the SVG.
error.svg_no_area: The SVG shapes have no area.
error.project_missing_part: The project references a missing file: {name}
error.project_no_object: Object {id} was not found in the project.
error.no_faces: No flat surface was found on this object.
error.nothing_on_face: Nothing of the design falls on this surface. Choose another surface or a different width.
error.picker: The file dialog is not available ({detail}). Use the upload button instead.
error.too_big: The file is too large (64 MB max).
error.busy: Another operation is running. Wait for it to finish.
error.no_window: This OrcaSlicer build cannot open plugin windows. Use the SVG Multicolor page instead.
error.denied_name: OrcaSlicer does not let plugins use a file or folder whose name contains “conf”, “cert” or “secret”: {path}. Rename it or move the file to another folder.
error.permission: OrcaSlicer blocked the plugin from reaching a file ({detail}). If you declined a permission prompt, allow it next time, or use a file in another folder.
error.deps_blocked: OrcaSlicer does not let the plugin load its libraries (numpy, shapely) at this point. Restart OrcaSlicer: the plugin loads them when OrcaSlicer starts.
whatsnew.title: What's new
whatsnew.local_note: Installed from a file: OrcaSlicer fills the Changelog tab only for plugins installed from OrcaCloud.
cfg.hint: SVG Multicolor starts with these values and remembers what you change on its page.
cfg.batch_note: Uses the settings of SVG Multicolor (the capability above).
